description_en: Creates or updates an exception archived table for a monitored object. Online version: v6.3.0
description_zh: 新建或者修改监控对象的异常归档表，上线版本号：v6.3.0
name: UpsertQualityArchiveTable

fields.help_en:
The mode for adding the archived table. Valid values:

CREATE_NEW_TABLE: creates a new table.
BIND_EXIST_TABLE: binds an existing table
fields.help_zh: 新增方式: CREATE_NEW_TABLE 新建表，BIND_EXIST_TABLE 绑定已有表
fields.name: add_mode

fields.help_en: The ID of the archived table. If this parameter is specified, the operation runs in update mode, and you cannot specify AddMode or NewTableNamePrefix. If this parameter is not specified, the operation runs in create mode
fields.help_zh: 归档表ID。传入时代表修改模式，此时禁止再传 AddMode 与 NewTableNamePrefix；不传时代表新建模式
fields.name: archive_table_id

fields.help_en: The name of the existing table. This parameter is required when AddMode is set to BIND_EXIST_TABLE. For Dataphin tables, use the format "project_name.table_name" (for example, dataphin03.ads_region_order_summary). For datasource tables, use the format "database/schema.table_name" (for example, order_db.order_exception_data). The table must belong to the same project or datasource as the monitored object, and the table schema must contain system fields with the dataphin_quality_ prefix
fields.help_zh: 已有表名称，AddMode=BIND_EXIST_TABLE 时必填。Dataphin 表格式为「项目名.表名」（如 dataphin03.ads_region_order_summary），数据源表格式为「database/schema.表名」（如 order_db.order_exception_data）。要求与监控对象同项目或同数据源，且表结构须包含 dataphin_quality_ 前缀的系统字段
fields.name: exist_table_name

fields.help_en: The lifecycle of the table, in days. The value must be a positive integer. If this parameter is not specified, no lifecycle is set. This parameter is valid only when creating a new table or in edit pattern, and only when the table belongs to MaxCompute, Hadoop series, or Hive. This parameter cannot be specified when AddMode is set to BIND_EXIST_TABLE
fields.help_zh: 生命周期，单位天，需为正整数；不传代表无生命周期。仅新建表或编辑模式、且表归属 MaxCompute / Hadoop 系列 / Hive 时可传，AddMode=BIND_EXIST_TABLE 时禁止传
fields.name: lifecycle

fields.help_en: The maximum number of archived rows. A positive integer specifies the limit on the number of archived rows. The console provides options of 10,000, 100,000, and 500,000. A value of -1 indicates full archiving. Default value: 10000. This parameter is supported only for MaxCompute, Hadoop series, or Hive
fields.help_zh: 最大归档条数。正整数代表限制归档条数（界面提供 1万/10万/50万，即 10000/100000/500000），-1 代表全量归档；不传默认 10000。仅 MaxCompute / Hadoop 系列 / Hive 支持
fields.name: max_archive_count

fields.help_en: The table name prefix for the new archived table. This parameter is required when AddMode is set to CREATE_NEW_TABLE. The system automatically appends the _exception_data suffix. For example, if you specify vip_user_tips112, the actual table name is vip_user_tips112_exception_data
fields.help_zh: 新建归档表的表名前缀，AddMode=CREATE_NEW_TABLE 时必填；系统会自动拼接 _exception_data 后缀，例如传 vip_user_tips112 实际建表为 vip_user_tips112_exception_data
fields.name: new_table_name_prefix

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to set the archived table as the active table. Only the value true is supported. After the table is set as active, the previously active table under the same monitored object is automatically deactivated (only one active table is allowed at a time). If you set this parameter to false, an InvalidParameter error is returned. If this parameter is not specified, the default value true is used. If this parameter is left empty, the active status remains unchanged
fields.help_zh: 是否设置为生效表。仅支持 true，设置后同一监控对象下原生效表自动取消生效（生效表恒定唯一）；传 false 会返回 InvalidParameter；不填默认 true；不传则不改变生效状态
fields.name: set_active

fields.help_en: The ID of the monitored object to which the archived table belongs
fields.name: watch_id

Data.description_en: The submit status of the asynchronous task

ProgressId.description_en: The progress ID of the asynchronous task. This is an asynchronous operation. After a successful submission, only this ID is returned. Call GetQualityArchiveTableProgress to poll the task status and retrieve the final archived table information
ProgressId.description_zh: 异步任务进度ID。本接口为异步接口，提交成功后仅返回该ID，需调用 GetQualityArchiveTableProgress 轮询任务状态与最终的归档表信息
ProgressId.title_en: 异步任务进度ID。本接口为异步接口，提交成功后仅返回该ID，需调用 GetQualityArchiveTableProgress 轮询任务状态与最终的归档表信息
ProgressId.title_zh: 异步任务进度ID。本接口为异步接口，提交成功后仅返回该ID，需调用 GetQualityArchiveTableProgress 轮询任务状态与最终的归档表信息

Message.description_en: The error details returned by the backend

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
